stock.description: Chi Kan Holdings Limited functions as an investment enterprise, primarily delivering specialized formwork and other construction-related services throughout both the People's Republic of China and Hong Kong. Its formwork offerings include conventional timber and plywood systems, alongside modern prefabricated options made from aluminum and steel. The company additionally operates within the e-commerce domain. Founded in 1989, and previously known as Chi Kan Woodworks Company Limited, this firm is based in Cheung Sha Wan, Hong Kong, and is a subsidiary of Magnificent Faith Limited.
